messages:
Asha: Quick poll — Lisbon offsite: red-eye Friday (arrive early Sat, crash at hotel) vs daytime Fri + extra night (more daylight to wander). Which do you pick? :airplane: :city_sunset:
Ben: Red-eye for me. Saves a day of hotel cost and I can nap on the plane. :zzz:
Diego: Daytime + extra night. Jetlag sucks, I'd rather arrive rested and not nap in meetings. Also free evening to grab dinner with folks.
Kayla: I vote red-eye but only if the hotel will hold luggage early. Any recs for hotels that do late check-in/early luggage? 
Teresa: FYI my neck pillow triggers airline security fun (long story). If you see a beige weird-shaped thing - that's me. :sweat_smile:
Asha: Good call about luggage. I'll ping travel concierge to confirm early-bag drop and gym hours. 
travel-bot: Reminder: group dinner RSVP closes Tue 10am. Also the hotel recommends arriving after 2pm for check-in; luggage storage available from 8am. Link: https://hotel.example/checkin
Ben: If anyone wants to split an extra night, DM me — could save on rooms. I'll also bring a power strip (EU -> US plug adapter) for the rooftop workspace.
Diego: Also pro tip: pack a lightweight foldable daypack + a packable rain shell. Lisbon weather can get weird evenings. 
Kayla: Agreed. And anyone into sunrise run groups? I can organize a 6:30am 5k along the river. 
Asha: Love that — count me in. I'll update the travel thread with final call once concierge confirms luggage. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
